# Markdown checklist templates for Smart Checklist

> Create checklists in Markdown format compatible with the Smart Checklist app for Jira. This repository provides reusable Markdown checklist templates, a formatting guide, and an LLM writing skill. The guide targets Jira Cloud.

## Start

- [Writing skill](skills/write-jira-checklist/SKILL.md): create or adapt checklist Markdown; ask for missing context when needed.
- [Formatting guide](skills/write-jira-checklist/references/formatting-guide.md): authoritative repository syntax reference.
- [Design practices](skills/write-jira-checklist/references/checklist-design.md): practical guidance with TitanApps sources.
- [JSON catalog](catalog.json): IDs, summaries, tags, paths, placeholders, sources, and caveats.
- [Human directory](templates/README.md): browse by team.

## Retrieval

Search catalog metadata first, then read a few matching template paths. Template files contain only checklist Markdown. Paste the checklist content into the Smart Checklist editor; keep catalog metadata and README prose outside it. Keep stable template IDs in attribution notes outside the payload. Resolve retired IDs through the successor entry’s superseded_ids; the search script also supports these aliases. Read contribution metadata to distinguish user-supplied replacements from historical blog sources.

All placeholders use descriptive lowercase snake_case names with at least two words and no curly brackets, such as document_url, due_date, and employee_name. They are draft markers, not app variables. Preserve the type-specific syntax around them: assignee attributes, @ mentions, links, images, and due-date attributes. Follow the formatting guide when replacing values. Use - for To Do, not - [ ]. Distinguish mentions from assignee attributes and mandatory markers from workflow validators. The skill can be used standalone; the catalog requires this repository.

T075 is a product regression example with illustrative JQL patterns; use T073 for general regression. T021 is historical migration guidance. Read each entry’s notes. Static checks are not a live Jira import test.
